profile.name: Geralt Heart
profile.pitch: Software engineer building automation, data pipelines, and AI-integrated tools: local LLMs, RAG, and MCP.
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer at Athena Manufacturing in Austin, where I started as an intern and was promoted to Software Engineer I. I build automation, data pipelines, and AI-integrated internal tools, and I deploy them as containers on-prem. I'm also finishing an MS in Computer Science (ML/Robotics) at CU Boulder. My background is applied math, and I like work where math, code, and systems meet.
profile.currently: building CLI + MCP developer tools; MS CS at CU Boulder (May 2027)
interests: Agent tooling and the Model Context Protocol
RLHF and the math of neural networks

experience.summary: Promoted from intern. Automation, data pipelines, and AI-integrated internal tools in a regulated manufacturing environment.

highlights.text: Deployed an agent orchestrator on Microsoft Azure that sends targeted Microsoft Teams notifications through Microsoft Graph. It resolves recipients from the company directory and keeps a full trace of every message, so jobs keep moving through production.

Built a reconciliation pipeline between the ERP database and the engineering-change tracking system, plus a .NET review interface where engineers confirm discrepancies before changes are committed. It unified the engineering change workflow.

Replaced free-text order linkage with a standardized data structure connecting sales orders to bills of materials and shortages. Purchasing and sales now share one view of shortages and job status, and nobody had to change how they work.

Built an on-prem natural-language-to-SQL assistant for the ERP on .NET 10. It runs local LLMs (Qwen3 and LLaMA) with hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): Qdrant vector search combined with BM25/n-gram keyword search. MCP tools handle structured queries, and OpenTelemetry traces every request.

Built and deployed a Kanban production scheduler (Python, Flask/Django) on Microsoft SQL Server via pyodbc. It replaced a manual queue with automated scheduling that minimizes retooling time and maximizes throughput.
Automated cross-database reconciliation between CNC machine data and the ERP, and integrated a document-control API so machinists see the right job documentation at each routing step.
Containerized and deployed applications to on-prem infrastructure that meets ITAR compliance requirements.
Evaluated AI-generated content for factual accuracy and hallucinations, supporting reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) pipelines.

projects.name: geraltheart.com
projects.tagline: This site: one JSON file feeds a terminal UI, a public MCP server, and an in-browser LLM.
projects.description: A terminal-style portfolio built so that people and agents read the same source. One content file drives the static site, a read-only Model Context Protocol server that Claude and other agents can connect to, an llms.txt, and an 'ask' chat that runs a small quantized model entirely in the visitor's browser with WebGPU. Answers are grounded in the content file and cite their source.
highlights: Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) on Cloudflare Workers, rate-limited and read-only
In-browser RAG: BM25 retrieval plus Qwen3 via WebLLM, with a citation guard that refuses to answer from outside the content
Works without JavaScript; keyboard-first, accessible terminal UI

projects.name: LiDAR Scout
projects.tagline: Multi-robot LiDAR pursuit simulator with A* planning and a shared occupancy map.
projects.description: Four robots sweep a noisy 360° LiDAR, build a shared occupancy grid, and chase a roaming target using A* path planning with obstacle inflation. Each robot uses a different pursuit strategy (predictive, ambush, direct, scatter) and runs its own finite-state machine (IDLE, CHASE, AVOID). The sensor model has configurable range, field of view, resolution, Gaussian noise, and dropout.
highlights: A* with obstacle inflation over a collaboratively mapped occupancy grid
Per-robot finite-state machines and pursuit strategies
Configurable LiDAR sensor model with noise and dropout
